# Operations Handbook

The orchestration runtime records tasks runs agent executions terminal chunks events routes results and conversations so operators can inspect each workflow after completion. The system keeps raw terminal data separate from business events and uses structured results for deterministic handoffs. The runtime selects enabled agents from configuration orders them by layer and execution order snapshots their configuration and executes one worker at a time. Reliability behavior includes bounded retries explicit terminal states graceful process shutdown and persistent history. The dashboard reports supported usage accurately and shows unavailable telemetry as unavailable rather than inventing measurements. Project discovery remains filesystem backed and workers run directly inside the selected repository. This paragraph intentionally repeats enough domain language to form a representative long note for conservative near duplicate detection.
